title: COMMONKIT: top up washer-01 float (0.05 NEAR)
description: Dorm B DAO only. Calls fund_float on the keyless washer-01 asset account with 0.05 NEAR from the DAO treasury. The asset sweeps anything above its float_cap back to the DAO, so a top-up can never park community money on the machine.
summary: fund_float washer-01 0.05 NEAR (Dorm B treasury -> washer-01 operating float)
